# OpenClaw Usage

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cses_wiki.py. Review before manual editing. -->

This wiki is designed to be mounted as a compact memory folder for an agent.
Exact OpenClaw configuration may vary, but the intended load policy is stable.

## Recommended Load Policy

Always load:

- `AI_CONTEXT.md`
- `ROUTER.md`
- `instructions/agent-behavior.md`
- `instructions/citation-policy.md`

Load on demand:

- `procedures/*.md` for workflow questions
- `topics/*.md` for domain questions
- `reference/glossary.md` and `reference/acronyms.md` for terminology
- `retrieval/chunks.jsonl` for keyword/vector retrieval

Avoid loading by default:

- `MANIFEST.json`
- full source documents in `knowledge_base_final/`
- very large source chunks unless retrieval identifies them as relevant

## Agent System Prompt Fragment

```text
Use cses_wiki/AI_CONTEXT.md and cses_wiki/ROUTER.md as the entry point.
For workflow questions, open one relevant procedure page. For domain questions,
open one relevant topic page. Open source documents only when exact wording,
provenance, dates, or policy authority matters. Cite source paths for procedural,
policy, privacy, and documentation-standard answers.
```

## Retrieval Setup

Index `retrieval/chunks.jsonl`. Use `context` plus `text` as the embedding text,
and retain `source_path`, `topic`, `year`, `status`, and `doc_type` as metadata.
Prefer chunks from `status=current` or `status=reference` over `historical` unless
the user asks about a specific historical period or event.
